## Checklist

- [ ] The PR title follows [Conventional Commits](https://www.conventionalcommits.org/)
- [ ] `cargo fmt`, `cargo clippy -- -D warnings` and `cargo test` pass locally
- [ ] Tests cover the change (bug fixes include a regression test)
- [ ] README feature table and roadmap are up to date
- [ ] `CHANGELOG.md` has an entry under **Unreleased**
- [ ] Architectural decisions are recorded as an ADR
- [ ] Screenshots are updated if the UI changed visibly
- [ ] Nothing logs or stores typed text
